reading: While describing Nvidia as a “good corporate citizen”, US Attorney General Todd Blanche declined to clarify whether the chipmaker was under federal investigation.
Blanche said he had no information about newly reinstated chief executive Jensen Huang’s security clearance.
Huang regained his position less than two weeks after being forced to resign following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.
Huang is due to face congressional scrutiny next week over national security concerns about his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy who led Megaspeed, a Singapore-based Nvidia customer.
The commerce department announced that it was preparing to blacklist Megaspeed, which was suspected of helping to divert advanced chips to China.

In a joint statement, the commerce and justice departments said they had begun investigating Megaspeed in 2024 over potential breaches of export controls, rules governing which goods may be sent abroad.
Blanche emphasised that the justice department had hundreds of export investigations under way at any given time.
Nvidia’s board defended its abrupt reversal on Huang’s leadership as serving the interests of shareholders, employees, partners and customers.
The board said it had received input from senior government officials and was confident that Huang’s reappointment posed no national security risk.
Trump said he had spoken to Nvidia’s directors and persuaded them to bring Huang back.
Senator Pete Ricketts argued that Huang’s conduct did not absolve Nvidia of its responsibility to answer concerns about national security and unaccounted-for chips.
Congressman Robert Garcia said Trump’s direct involvement in the decision raised serious questions about national security and corruption.
Senator Ruben Gallego called for an investigation into stock positions held before the reappointment announcement.
Although Nvidia shares closed nearly 6% lower, they remained above their level at the end of the previous week.
Monday’s increase had exceeded 31% following news of Huang’s return.
Trump said he would consider pardoning Huang for any potential criminal activity, while indicating that he did not expect a pardon to be needed.

vocabulary.definition: A company viewed in terms of its responsibilities towards society and its conduct under the law.
Chose not to provide an explanation that would make an uncertain matter clearer; a restrained expression often used in formal reporting.
Official authorisation allowing someone access to particular sensitive information.
Close, critical examination intended to assess conduct, decisions or possible problems.
To redirect goods away from their intended destination or route.
Government rules governing which goods or technologies may be sent abroad and under what conditions.
A change that replaces an earlier decision or position with its opposite.
To release someone from blame or responsibility; here, from an obligation to explain the company’s conduct.
Not satisfactorily explained in terms of location, use or what happened.
Investors’ holdings in company shares at a particular time.

entries.ja: 社会に対する責任や、法に照らした行動という観点から捉えた企業。
entries.ko: 사회에 대한 책임과 법에 비추어 본 행동이라는 관점에서 바라본 기업.
entries.zh-Hans: 从对社会承担的责任以及法律框架下的行为表现这一角度看待的企业。
entries.es: Empresa considerada desde el punto de vista de sus responsabilidades hacia la sociedad y de su conducta ante la ley.
entries.pt-BR: Empresa vista em termos de suas responsabilidades perante a sociedade e de sua conduta em relação à lei.
entries.fr: Entreprise considérée sous l’angle de ses responsabilités envers la société et de sa conduite au regard de la loi.
entries.de: Ein Unternehmen, betrachtet im Hinblick auf seine Verantwortung gegenüber der Gesellschaft und sein Verhalten im Rahmen der Gesetze.

entries.ja: 不確かな事柄をより明確にするための説明を、あえてしなかったということ。正式な報道でよく使われる、控えめな表現。
entries.ko: 불확실한 사안을 더 명확하게 해 줄 설명을 제공하지 않기로 했다는 뜻. 격식을 갖춘 보도에서 자주 쓰이는 절제된 표현.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择不作出能让不明确的事情变得更清楚的解释；这是正式报道中常用的一种克制表达。
entries.es: Optó por no dar una explicación que aclarara un asunto incierto; es una expresión mesurada que suele utilizarse en la información periodística formal.
entries.pt-BR: Optou por não dar uma explicação que tornasse mais claro um assunto incerto; é uma expressão contida, frequentemente usada em reportagens formais.
entries.fr: A choisi de ne pas fournir d’explication permettant d’éclaircir une question incertaine ; c’est une formulation mesurée souvent utilisée dans les reportages de ton formel.
entries.de: Entschied sich dagegen, eine Erklärung abzugeben, die einen unklaren Sachverhalt verständlicher gemacht hätte; eine zurückhaltende Formulierung, die häufig in der förmlichen Berichterstattung verwendet wird.

entries.ja: 特定の機密性の高い情報へのアクセスを認める正式な許可。
entries.ko: 특정한 민감 정보에 접근할 수 있도록 하는 공식적인 허가.
entries.zh-Hans: 允许某人接触特定敏感信息的官方授权。
entries.es: Autorización oficial que permite a una persona acceder a determinada información sensible.
entries.pt-BR: Autorização oficial que permite a alguém acessar determinadas informações sensíveis.
entries.fr: Autorisation officielle permettant à une personne d’accéder à certaines informations sensibles.
entries.de: Eine offizielle Genehmigung, die einer Person Zugang zu bestimmten sensiblen Informationen erlaubt.

entries.ja: 行動や決定、または問題がある可能性について評価するための、綿密で批判的な検討。
entries.ko: 행동이나 결정, 또는 잠재적인 문제를 평가하기 위한 면밀하고 비판적인 검토.
entries.zh-Hans: 为评估行为、决定或可能存在的问题而进行的细致、审慎且带有质疑态度的审查。
entries.es: Examen minucioso y crítico destinado a evaluar conductas, decisiones o posibles problemas.
entries.pt-BR: Exame minucioso e crítico destinado a avaliar condutas, decisões ou possíveis problemas.
entries.fr: Examen attentif et critique visant à évaluer des comportements, des décisions ou d’éventuels problèmes.
entries.de: Eine genaue, kritische Prüfung, mit der Verhalten, Entscheidungen oder mögliche Probleme beurteilt werden sollen.

entries.ja: 物品を、本来予定されていた目的地や経路とは別のところへ向かわせること。
entries.ko: 물품이 원래 예정된 목적지나 경로가 아닌 다른 곳으로 가도록 돌리는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 使货物偏离原定的目的地或运输路线，转向其他地方。
entries.es: Redirigir mercancías hacia un destino o por una ruta distintos de los previstos.
entries.pt-BR: Redirecionar mercadorias para um destino ou uma rota diferentes dos previstos.
entries.fr: Détourner des marchandises de leur destination ou de leur itinéraire prévus.
entries.de: Waren von ihrem vorgesehenen Ziel oder Transportweg weg zu einem anderen Ziel oder auf einen anderen Weg umleiten.

entries.ja: どのような物品や技術を、どのような条件で国外に送ることができるかを定める政府の規則。
entries.ko: 어떤 물품이나 기술을 어떤 조건에서 해외로 보낼 수 있는지 정하는 정부의 규정.
entries.zh-Hans: 规定哪些货物或技术可以送往国外，以及必须满足哪些条件的政府规则。
entries.es: Normas gubernamentales que determinan qué bienes o tecnologías pueden enviarse al extranjero y bajo qué condiciones.
entries.pt-BR: Regras do governo que determinam quais bens ou tecnologias podem ser enviados ao exterior e sob quais condições.
entries.fr: Règles gouvernementales déterminant quels biens ou technologies peuvent être envoyés à l’étranger et à quelles conditions.
entries.de: Staatliche Regeln, die festlegen, welche Waren oder Technologien unter welchen Bedingungen ins Ausland geliefert werden dürfen.

entries.ja: 以前の決定や立場を、それとは正反対のものに置き換える変更。
entries.ko: 이전의 결정이나 입장을 그와 정반대되는 것으로 바꾸는 변화.
entries.zh-Hans: 将先前的决定或立场改为与之相反的决定或立场的变化。
entries.es: Cambio que sustituye una decisión o postura anterior por la contraria.
entries.pt-BR: Mudança que substitui uma decisão ou posição anterior pela oposta.
entries.fr: Changement qui remplace une décision ou une position antérieure par son contraire.
entries.de: Eine Änderung, bei der eine frühere Entscheidung oder Haltung durch ihr Gegenteil ersetzt wird.

entries.ja: 誰かに対する非難や責任を免除すること。ここでは、会社の行動を説明する義務を免除すること。
entries.ko: 누군가에게 잘못에 대한 비난이나 책임을 면해 주는 것. 여기서는 회사의 행동을 설명할 의무에서 벗어나게 하는 것을 뜻함.
entries.zh-Hans: 免除某人应受的责备或承担的责任；在这里，指免除解释公司行为的义务。
entries.es: Liberar a alguien de culpa o responsabilidad; aquí, de la obligación de explicar la conducta de la empresa.
entries.pt-BR: Livrar alguém de culpa ou responsabilidade; aqui, da obrigação de explicar a conduta da empresa.
entries.fr: Exempter quelqu’un de blâme ou de responsabilité ; ici, de l’obligation d’expliquer la conduite de l’entreprise.
entries.de: Jemanden von Schuld oder Verantwortung befreien; hier von der Pflicht, das Verhalten des Unternehmens zu erklären.

entries.ja: 所在、使い道、または何が起きたかについて、納得のいく説明がなされていないこと。
entries.ko: 어디에 있는지, 어떻게 사용되었는지, 또는 어떻게 되었는지에 대해 납득할 만한 설명이 없는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 其所在位置、使用情况或发生了什么尚未得到令人满意的解释。
entries.es: Sin una explicación satisfactoria sobre dónde está algo, su uso o lo que le ha ocurrido.
entries.pt-BR: Sem explicação satisfatória sobre onde algo está, seu uso ou o que aconteceu com ele.
entries.fr: Dont l’emplacement, l’utilisation ou le devenir n’ont pas été expliqués de manière satisfaisante.
entries.de: Ohne zufriedenstellende Erklärung dazu, wo sich etwas befindet, wie es verwendet wird oder was damit geschehen ist.

entries.ja: ある時点で投資家が保有している企業の株式。
entries.ko: 특정 시점에 투자자들이 보유하고 있는 기업의 주식.
entries.zh-Hans: 投资者在某一特定时间持有的公司股票。
entries.es: Acciones de empresas que los inversores poseen en un momento determinado.
entries.pt-BR: Ações de empresas que os investidores possuem em um determinado momento.
entries.fr: Actions d’entreprises détenues par des investisseurs à un moment donné.
entries.de: Die Unternehmensaktien, die Anleger zu einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt halten.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
